# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks whether comments have a leading space after the
      # `#` denoting the start of the comment. The leading space is not
      # required for some RDoc special syntax, like `#++`, `#--`,
      # `#:nodoc`, `=begin`- and `=end` comments, "shebang" directives,
      # or rackup options.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   #Some comment
      #
      #   # good
      #   # Some comment
      #
      # @example AllowDoxygenCommentStyle: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   #**
      #   # Some comment
      #   # Another line of comment
      #   #*
      #
      # @example AllowDoxygenCommentStyle: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   #**
      #   # Some comment
      #   # Another line of comment
      #   #*
      #
      # @example AllowGemfileRubyComment: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   #ruby=2.7.0
      #   #ruby-gemset=myproject
      #
      # @example AllowGemfileRubyComment: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   #ruby=2.7.0
      #   #ruby-gemset=myproject
      #
      # @example AllowRBSInlineAnnotation: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   include Enumerable #[Integer]
      #
      #   attr_reader :name #: String
      #   attr_reader :age  #: Integer?
      #
      # @example AllowRBSInlineAnnotation: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   include Enumerable #[Integer]
      #
      #   attr_reader :name #: String
      #   attr_reader :age  #: Integer?
      #
      # @example AllowSteepAnnotation: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #   [1, 2, 3].each_with_object([]) do |n, list| #$ Array[Integer]
      #     list << n
      #   end
      #
      #   name = 'John'      #: String
      #
      # @example AllowSteepAnnotation: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   [1, 2, 3].each_with_object([]) do |n, list| #$ Array[Integer]
      #     list << n
      #   end
      #
      #   name = 'John'      #: String
      #
      class LeadingCommentSpace < Base
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Missing space after `#`.'
        MAGIC_TOKEN = '(?<token>[[:alnum:]\-_]+)'
        MAGIC_KEYWORDS = {
          encoding: '(?:en)?coding',
          frozen_string_literal: 'frozen[_-]string[_-]literal',
          shareable_constant_value: 'shareable[_-]constant[_-]value',
          typed: 'typed'
        }.freeze
        EMACS_MAGIC_REGEXP = /-\*-(?<token>.+)-\*-/.freeze
        VIM_MAGIC_REGEXP = /#\s*vim:\s*(?<token>.+)/.freeze
        DIRECTIVE_COMMENT_REGEXP = Regexp.new(
          "# rubocop : ((?:disable|enable|todo))\\b ((?:all|(?:([A-Z]\\w+/)*(?:[A-Z]\\w+) , )*([A-Z]\\w+/)*(?:[A-Z]\\w+)))"
            .gsub(' ', '\s*')
        )

        def self.comment_workspace
          Thread.current[:rubocop_leading_comment_workspace] ||= allocate
        end

        def self.parse_magic_comment(text)
          comment_workspace.send(:parse_magic_comment_text, text)
        end

        def self.coerce_frozen_literal(setting)
          comment_workspace.send(:coerce_magic_frozen_literal, setting)
        end

        def self.disabled_line_ranges_for(comment_config)
          comment_workspace.send(:analyze_disabled_line_ranges, comment_config)
        end

        def self.extra_enabled_comments_for(comment_config, extras:, names:)
          comment_workspace.send(:collect_extra_enabled_comments, comment_config, extras, names)
        end

        def self.consecutive_comment_groups(comments)
          comment_workspace.send(:group_consecutive_comments, comments)
        end

        def self.empty_comment_text?(text, allow_border:)
          comment_workspace.send(:empty_hash_comment?, text, allow_border)
        end

        def on_new_investigation # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
          @leading_comment_records = []
          @leading_comment_flags = {}
          bind_leading_comment_workspace
          processed_source.comments.each do |comment|
            next unless /\A(?!#\+\+|#--)(#+[^#\s=])/.match?(comment.text)
            next if comment.loc.line == 1 && allowed_on_first_line?(comment)
            next if doxygen_comment_style?(comment)
            next if gemfile_ruby_comment?(comment)
            next if rbs_inline_annotation?(comment)
            next if steep_annotation?(comment)

            add_offense(comment) do |corrector|
              expr = comment.source_range

              corrector.insert_after(hash_mark(expr), ' ')
            end
          end
        end

        private

        def hash_mark(expr)
          range_between(expr.begin_pos, expr.begin_pos + 1)
        end

        def allowed_on_first_line?(comment)
          @leading_comment_flags ||= {}
          @leading_comment_records ||= []
          allowed = shebang?(comment) || (rackup_config_file? && rackup_options?(comment))
          if allowed
            @leading_comment_flags[:first_line_allowed] = true
            @leading_comment_records << [:first_line, comment]
          else
            @leading_comment_flags[:first_line_allowed] = false unless @leading_comment_flags[:first_line_allowed]
          end
          allowed
        end

        def shebang?(comment)
          comment.text.start_with?('#!')
        end

        def rackup_options?(comment)
          comment.text.start_with?('#\\')
        end

        def rackup_config_file?
          @leading_comment_flags ||= {}
          @leading_comment_records ||= []
          result = File.basename(processed_source.file_path).eql?('config.ru')
          @leading_comment_flags[:rackup_file] = result
          @leading_comment_records << [:rackup_file, processed_source.file_path] if result
          result
        end

        def allow_doxygen_comment?
          @leading_comment_flags ||= {}
          @leading_comment_records ||= []
          allowed = cop_config['AllowDoxygenCommentStyle']
          @leading_comment_flags[:allow_doxygen] = allowed
          @leading_comment_records << [:allow_doxygen, allowed]
          allowed
        end
